basic_profile.bio: Greetings! I'm a software developer based in Seattle with a keen interest in technology and gaming. By day, I work as a senior developer at a tech firm, and by night, I'm an avid gamer exploring the realms of RPGs and classic games like Diablo 2. My interests include tinkering with tech gadgets, exploring new gaming consoles, and diving into fantasy novels. I'm currently in a long-term relationship and enjoy spending weekends hiking in the beautiful Pacific Northwest. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work and sporadically during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have over a decade of experience in software development, focusing particularly on .NET technologies. My passion for gaming and technology has driven me to self-learn about the latest in gaming consoles and display technologies, often helping fellow enthusiasts troubleshoot their tech issues.
